title.zh: 美国政府将查获的比特币及加密货币转入Coinbase Prime
title.en: US Government Moves Seized Bitcoin and Crypto to Coinbase Prime

current_state.zh: 美国政府关联钱包已连续三个晚上转出比特币，包括10月8日的12,267枚BTC（约10.06亿美元），其中9,000枚（约7.39亿美元）被追踪至Coinbase Prime；此前还有10月7日约8,428枚BTC和10月6日834枚BTC转入Coinbase Prime。比特币价格同期跌至约82,500美元。这些资产是托管还是最终清算仍不确定。
current_state.en: US government-linked wallets have moved Bitcoin on three consecutive nights, including 12,267 BTC on Oct. 8 (~$1.006 billion), of which 9,000 BTC (~$739 million) was traced to Coinbase Prime; earlier transfers included about 8,428 BTC on Oct. 7 and 834 BTC on Oct. 6 to Coinbase Prime. BTC fell to about $82,500 over the period. Whether the assets are for custody or eventual liquidation remains unconfirmed.

updates.title_zh: 美国政府将4.7亿美元扣押加密货币转入Coinbase钱包，引发比特币出售疑问
updates.title_en: US government moves $470 million in seized crypto to Coinbase wallets, raising Bitcoin sale questions
updates.what_changed_zh: Arkham报告称，美国政府钱包将约4.7亿美元与Bitfinex黑客事件和Alameda相关的扣押比特币、封装比特币和USDT转入可能是Coinbase Prime的地址，重新引发了对政府可能出售的猜测，尽管出售尚未得到证实。
updates.what_changed_en: Arkham reported that US government wallets moved about $470 million in seized Bitcoin, wrapped Bitcoin and USDT linked to the Bitfinex hack and Alameda to likely Coinbase Prime addresses, reviving speculation about potential government sales even though a sale is unconfirmed.

updates.title_zh: 🔍  链上侦探 |  美国政府凌晨持续转移大量加密资产，近32小时累计转出价值6.7亿美元代币
updates.title_en: 🔍  链上侦探 |  美国政府凌晨持续转移大量加密资产，近32小时累计转出价值6.7亿美元代币
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国政府地址在约32小时内持续转出累计价值约6.7亿美元的加密资产，包括6,215.7枚BTC（约5.2亿美元）、1.19亿枚USDT和40,285枚BNB（约3163万美元），其中BTC和USDT均转入Coinbase Prime。
updates.what_changed_en: US government addresses continued transferring crypto over roughly 32 hours, with cumulative outflows around $670 million including 6,215.7 BTC (~$520 million), 119 million USDT and 40,285 BNB (~$31.63 million), with the BTC and USDT routed into Coinbase Prime.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国政府相关地址持续向Coinbase Prime等地址转移大量加密资产，近32小时累计转出约6.7亿美元，涉及BTC、USDT和BNB，市场对潜在出售的猜测升温但尚未确认。
updates.current_state_en: US government-linked addresses continued moving large amounts of crypto to Coinbase Prime and other addresses, with about $670 million transferred over roughly 32 hours across BTC, USDT and BNB, fueling unconfirmed speculation about potential sales.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: US government addresses transferred roughly $670 million worth of crypto over 32 hours — including 6,215.7 BTC, 119 million USDT and 40,285 BNB — with the BTC and USDT all routed into Coinbase Prime.
updates.detailed_summary_en: US government addresses transferred roughly $670 million worth of crypto over 32 hours — including 6,215.7 BTC, 119 million USDT and 40,285 BNB — with the BTC and USDT all routed into Coinbase Prime.

updates.title_zh: 🔍  链上侦探 |  美国政府地址再次转移12267.02枚BTC，约10.06亿美元
updates.title_en: 🔍  链上侦探 |  美国政府地址再次转移12267.02枚BTC，约10.06亿美元
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国政府Bitfinex黑客被没收资金相关地址再次转出12,267.02枚BTC（约10.06亿美元），其中6,000枚分两笔转入新地址33pYK…cFk，剩余约6,267枚暂存于另一新地址；这是在前述约6.7亿美元BTC、USDT和BNB转入Coinbase Prime之后的后续大额转移。
updates.what_changed_en: A US government address tied to seized Bitfinex hacker funds transferred an additional 12,267.02 BTC (~$1.006 billion), with 6,000 BTC split into a new address 33pYK…cFk and the remaining ~6,267 BTC held in another new address; this follows the earlier ~$670 million in BTC, USDT and BNB routed into Coinbase Prime.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国政府相关地址在先前约6.7亿美元资产转入Coinbase Prime后，再次转出12,267.02枚BTC（约10.06亿美元），其中6,000枚转入新地址，约6,267枚暂存另一新地址；是否最终托管或清算仍不确定。
updates.current_state_en: After earlier routing roughly $670 million into Coinbase Prime, US government-linked addresses moved an additional 12,267.02 BTC (~$1.006 billion), with 6,000 BTC sent to a new address and about 6,267 BTC held in another new address; whether this is for custody or eventual liquidation remains unconfirmed.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: A US government address tied to seized Bitfinex hacker funds transferred 12,267.02 BTC (~$1.006 billion), with 6,000 BTC split into a new address and the rest held in another, following ~$670M of BTC, USDT and BNB moved earlier into Coinbase Prime.
updates.detailed_summary_en: A US government address tied to seized Bitfinex hacker funds transferred 12,267.02 BTC (~$1.006 billion), with 6,000 BTC split into a new address and the rest held in another, following ~$670M of BTC, USDT and BNB moved earlier into Coinbase Prime.
updates.background_zh: 这批资金可追溯至 2016 年的 Bitfinex 黑客事件，由美国政府缴获，美方曾宣布在该案中追回 36 亿美元资产。2025 年，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普签署行政令设立「战略比特币储备」，其中包含美国执法部门缴获的比特币。
updates.background_en: The funds trace back to the 2016 Bitfinex hack and were seized by US authorities, who announced a $3.6 billion recovery from the case. In 2025, President Donald Trump signed an executive order creating a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve that includes Bitcoin seized by US law enforcement.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径主要经由市场情绪与比特币现货潜在的供给压力，而币安的去向终端是兼具托管与交易功能的 Coinbase Prime。转账期间比特币价格从约 86,500 美元回落至约 82,500 美元，但尚无抛售得到确认。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through sentiment and potential supply overhang on Bitcoin spot markets, with Coinbase Prime as the custody and trading venue where the coins have arrived. The transfers coincided with Bitcoin falling from about $86,500 to around $82,500, but no liquidation has been confirmed.
